title: About The Grand • Premier Event Venues in Lucknow
desc: The Grand is a premier event estate in Bindaua, Raibareli Rd, Lucknow: five distinct venues, manicured gardens and 64 guest rooms for weddings and celebrations.

runs.I believe a temporary home deserves as m: We believe a celebration deserves as much care as your own home. runs.I studied tourism and spent many years w: The Grand Lucknow stands in the heart of Lucknow, surrounded by lush greenery and pristine landscapes. Our five distinct venues suit an intimate gathering or a grand celebration, from weddings to corporate events.
